title: Historical source incidents and four passing calibrations
claim: Eight retained history excerpts support bounded source leads. All four authored BR-003 prototypes passed once under Terra/high on different endpoints; authentic vector-crop ownership remained untested. Historical reports are not benchmark failures.
limitations: Selected history: nine exports, eight excerpt records from six sessions; exact recalled timeout/reroute and SVG incidents were not recovered.
Four different endpoints and one model attempt each cannot be pooled; H03/H04 share one CT and QA packets are correlated.
The native experiment index covers six medical executions; the separate full-round audit covers all twelve original results.
Read-only byte/result verification, not fresh model execution, saved-code replay, clinical adjudication or runtime recovery. Historical parking decisions and scores are unchanged.
